# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/5068

## What does this PR do?
- Make a new Progress type that can holds multiple steps
- Implement the progress on all the batches type
- Update the tests

issue_context.body:
Related product team resources: [PRD](https://www.notion.so/meilisearch/Enhance-visibility-on-batched-tasks-1194b06b651f80889e58d2862a4662bc) (_internal only_)
Related product discussion:

Follow-up work on https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/4977

## Motivation

In #4977, we introduced a lot of new information to help the user understand that there is a batch and get a quick glance at what they've done.
But the part about the `progress` field of the batch object is still missing, and that's a very important part of helping the user what's going on **currently**.

## Usage

https://www.notion.so/meilisearch/Enhance-visibility-on-batched-tasks-1194b06b651f810b8fe0fab5d72846a8

@meilisearch/integration-team
